Tapestry Solutions, a Boeing company, is hiring an Entry-Level Software Engineer to develop and maintain weapon-planning software for the U.S. Air Force and the Department of Defense’s next-generation Mission Planning system. The role contributes to a SAFe Agile scrum team working with a microservices architecture and supports software design, testing, integration, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

Performs troubleshooting of defects. Collaborates with others to propose solutions to problems
Assists in the specification and maintenance of software requirements
Integrates and compiles software components into builds
